title: Who is who in The Third Level
back: Charley (narrator, 31), Louisa (anxious wife), Sam (psychiatrist who escapes), the 1894 clerk.

title: The Third Level in six beats
back: Two levels → lost → 1894 → Galesburg refused → old money → first-day cover.

title: Why Sam can't go back to his old business
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Line to remember" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g><rect x="28" y="36" width="264" height="72" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" rx="10"/><path d="M50,108 L42,122 L64,108 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><text x="160.0" y="68.05" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">not in Galesburg, Illinois,</text><text x="160.0" y="85.05" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">in 1894</text></g><text x="160" y="146" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.8" stroke="none">— because Sam was a psychiatrist</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Line to remember</text></svg>
